General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) is a technology and professional services company delivering technology solutions and mission services to government, defense, and intelligence organizations. The Full-Stack Software Developer will support software development lifecycle activities, analyze business needs, design software systems, and provide operational support for Intelligence Community missions. The role also involves developing web services and applications, supporting quality assurance and DevOps practices, and collaborating with dispersed Agile teams.
